cand.title: ISCT 2027 Annual Meeting
cand.organizationName: International Society for Cell & Gene Therapy
cand.excerpt: Strong organized hospitality-demand mechanism and confirmed Toronto date; venue commitment reduces current-edition accessibility.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Giovanni Guizzetti, Global Conference Manager, is the strongest operational approach: his current industry-event profile says he leads ISCT international conference planning and delivery and manages the full event lifecycle. Queenie Jang, Chief Executive Officer, is the senior relationship/escalation contact; the CEO chairs the committee overseeing society operations and management. Jenny Simmons, Industry Affairs Lead, is the explicitly named 2027 sponsorship contact and a relevant route to exhibitor/corporate-side demand, not a verified housing buyer. No source establishes any named individual's hotel-contract signature authority. Route annual-meeting housing questions through meetings@isctglobal.org.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition within the requested horizon: May 12–15, 2027, Toronto. The official event calendar gives actual activity times of May 12 at 08:00 through May 15 at 17:00 ET; these are not publication dates. A subsequent annual meeting is officially announced for Canada, May 31–June 3, 2028, but its city and venue are not announced. Do not assume Toronto for 2028.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: strong city-convention proximity fit, not a resort retreat fit. A 157-room Harbourfront hotel cannot be exclusive housing or the plenary venue for the meeting's marketed 3,000+ global delegates. Realistic targets are a modest delegate/exhibitor room allocation, speaker/VIP lodging, or small side meetings; approximately 15–109 peak rooms is a sales-screening envelope supplied in the brief, NOT published event demand. The 240-theatre largest room is unsuitable for the main congress. Side-meeting/reception catering must remain conditional on verifying current restaurant/lounge and banquet operations. No actual room pickup for this hotel is published.
findings.venueCommitments: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, 255 Front St W, Toronto, Ontario M5V 2W6. This is Toronto proper, downtown and within the supplied MTCC territory, not an outlying resort or a competing hotel. Both ISCT and the convention centre list the 2027 event. Public announcement establishes the venue commitment, not the commercial terms or a hotel contract. Building, halls and room assignments were not established.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified global annual-meeting sequence: Paris 2023; Vancouver 2024; New Orleans 2025; Dublin 2026; Toronto 2027; Canada 2028 with destination to be announced. This establishes recurrence and destination rotation, not an annual Toronto demand cycle or an open future venue bid. Historical convention venues are not evidence of current available hotel inventory.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The official 2027 Abstract FAQ states: “ISCT hotel block booking links are provided in each delegate's registration confirmation email. Group hotel booking is not possible. Only registered delegates will be able to access ISCT preferred rates and hotel reservation links.” It adds: “we anticipate our blocks will sell out ahead of the cut off dates.” Thus an organizer-directed individual-delegate block pathway is published; it is not an open hotel RFP. Every named 2027 hotel found: none. No public Toronto property list, host hotel, housing bureau/PCO name, rates, block sizes, booking cutoffs or peak-room/room-night totals were verified. No evidence establishes Radisson inclusion or exclusion. The FAQ is edition-branded but generic; registration still says “opens November 2026,” while the homepage roadmap says October 2026. Confirm implementation directly rather than assuming the block portal is already operating. Other editions' housing agencies or hotels must not be carried over to Toronto.
findings.organizationStructure: ISCT is the event-owning professional society/association, distinct from its convention venue. Its Board of Directors handles governance and strategic oversight; the CEO-chaired Executive Management Committee oversees operations and management; a dedicated Vancouver head office supports the society. No current Toronto-edition third-party PCO, DMC or housing bureau was established. Do not treat a venue or another edition's accommodation partner as the Toronto buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The announced MTCC venue and existing ISCT-block booking pathway limit primary-congress displacement and unrestricted housing access. Incumbent hotel identities and allocations remain unknown, so “all lodging committed elsewhere” is not established. ISCT's statement that blocks may sell out is a prospective organizer warning, not proof of a sellout, compression, unmet demand or a currently available overflow contract. No sourced competitor rates or overflow volumes were found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Giovanni Guizzetti via meetings@isctglobal.org with a concise supplemental-room proposal for May 12–15, 2027; ask who manages accommodation contracts, request the complete edition-specific hotel roster and block/cutoff details, and ask whether additional individual-booking inventory or permitted speaker/exhibitor allocations are still accepted. Position the supplied 157-room hotel as nearby Harbourfront lodging, not exclusive congress housing; negotiate inventory only after availability and sourcing acceptance are verified. Contact Jenny Simmons at jennifer@isctglobal.org for permitted corporate/exhibitor-side introductions, not presumed lodging control. Use Queenie Jang for senior relationship development if needed. Ask the conference team whether 2028 destination decisions are already committed and monitor the official announcement before pitching Toronto. Verify hotel F&B before proposing catered functions.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is a confirmed future event, but not a verified open sourcing opportunity. Published delegate hotel blocks indicate an incumbent accommodation pathway; supplemental inventory acceptance, the responsible contracting entity and Radisson participation are unconfirmed. Qualify as venue_confirmed with conditional lodging access, rather than treating the seed's likely_closed_incumbent label as a proven total closure. No room revenue should be forecast until the organizer confirms a viable route.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: cultivate the conference team for repeat relationships and supplemental lodging when the series returns to this territory. The next announced edition is May 31–June 3, 2028 in Canada, destination to be announced; this is not evidence that Toronto is selected, that city selection remains competitive, or that accommodation bids are open. Rotation supports monitoring and relationship development, not recurring Toronto room demand.
